Issue 772: analyze() self-intersection is opt-in and representable::defaultDoesNotCheck

kernel_output.data: no kernel call: analyze() without selfIntersectionTimeout never reaches OCCTShapeSelfIntersectsBounded, which is what the test asserts

source: No kernel counterpart. The test asserts hasSelfIntersection == nil for a box and for the overlapping compound when analyze() is called with no selfIntersectionTimeout, i.e. that the kernel check is NOT run (Swift-side opt-in guard). bridge_output is the two asserted nils.

test_name: Issue 772: analyze() self-intersection is opt-in and representable::nonNilTimeoutOnCleanShapePopulatesFalse
source: Same quantity on both sides: whether the 10x10x10 box self-intersects, as a boolean. Bridge: analyze(tolerance: 0.001, selfIntersectionTimeout: 30).hasSelfIntersection, asserted == false. Kernel: Scripts/repro/766-healing-702-999/transcript.txt line 7 ('#772 self-intersection: box=0 overlapping compound=1'); the probe's selfInter() returns 1 when BOPAlgo_ArgumentAnalyzer (SelfInterMode, StopOnFirstFaulty) reports BOPAlgo_SelfIntersect and 0 otherwise, so 0 is false and 1 is true.

test_name: Issue 772: analyze() self-intersection is opt-in and representable::nonNilTimeoutOnSelfIntersectingShapePopulatesTrue
source: Same quantity on both sides: whether the compound of two overlapping 10x10x10 boxes (offset 5 in X) self-intersects, as a boolean. Bridge: analyze(tolerance: 0.001, selfIntersectionTimeout: 30).hasSelfIntersection, asserted == true. Kernel: Scripts/repro/766-healing-702-999/transcript.txt line 7 ('#772 self-intersection: box=0 overlapping compound=1'); the probe's selfInter() returns 1 when BOPAlgo_ArgumentAnalyzer (SelfInterMode, StopOnFirstFaulty) reports BOPAlgo_SelfIntersect and 0 otherwise, so 0 is false and 1 is true.
